pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped polygonal regions of dark pigment. Geometry is characterized by softened edge gradients at the current resolution, with shapes ranging from quadrangular to hexagonal. Spatial area of patches is highest on the mid-flank and decreases toward the posterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a geometric grid. Junction nodes predominantly consist of three-way and four-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively stable with minor local variations in pixel width between adjacent patches.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism perched on the posterior dorsal region near the rump, creating a localized silhouette disruption.
